title: Mickey rescue counter and diagnostics
status: Catalog and static review complete. No game/UI access or product changes by this reviewer.
scope: One-time saved-counter edit and seven read-only diagnostics. No actor creation, forced rescue, RNG call, or save-file operation.

tests.review: Read the RescueTests fixture and IPC/capability integration checks. Root reports 178 checks, zero failures after adding four Mission/Camera IPC/capability checks; RescueTests are unchanged. No build or test execution by this reviewer. The old player_bridge_results.txt predates these additions; use the root release test log for the final run.

layout.meaning: Rescue-use count; exponent in the native roll formula
Loaded parameters: float decay at +216 and float minimum at +220
Mission singleton; supported storage RVA 0x2A0F8B0; resource pointer +8, uint16 flags +4 with bit 0x200
Game-over object: int type +0, int phase +16, uint8 selected +20

mutation_gates: Exact base and game thread; nonzero host heartbeat no older than 5000 ms; not disabled.
Scene loaded, no unload or pending room transition; field scheduler readable and loaded SaveData header equals 0x0000003A4A32484B.
Active field state 1; no menu, cutscene or game-over sequence.
Fresh current actor pointer, readable actor/status, matching status pointer and packed actor backlink, living Sora character ID 1.
Existing use count and new integer both in 0..999; exactly two writable bytes.
restore_behavior: The command changes loaded SaveData once. Disable all effects and disconnect leave it applied; a later normal game save may retain it. No profile replay is allowed.
snapshot_semantics: Diagnostics also permit field state 2. The shared snapshot clears validity before publication. Missing/malformed data omit affected values; a missing mission or game-over object explicitly publishes inactive flags. Inactive game-over child values remain invalid.
covered_synthetic_cases: IPC command 1176, value publication and capability slots 176..183.
Counts 0 and 999; invalid negative, fractional, 1000, NaN and Infinity input.
Full SaveData byte comparison: only the two counter bytes may change; appearance count and RNG sentinel remain unchanged.
Wrong loaded-save header, non-Sora/dead actor, active game-over, menu, event, pending transition, paused or lost scene, wrong thread, expired host and an actual read-only counter page.
Formula count 0, count 3 and count 999 with floor; malformed parameter suppression.
Mission absent/eligible/unreadable resource; game-over absent/valid/malformed phase; validity clearing.
limitations: No runtime or visual behavior was tested by this reviewer.
An observed 100% conditional threshold is not a guarantee: native eligibility and strict RNG comparison remain in force.
The module relies on the shared bridge's game-thread serialization and valid build/base contract.
Only selected inspected functions receive claims; no completeness claim is made.

claims.Finding: Initial rescue selection is limited to the inspected game-over type 0 and requires mission permission plus native party conditions. It derives the roll threshold from unsigned SaveData counter RVA 0x9AD660 using powf and a minimum floor, then compares against a native RNG value. The object stores type at +0 and selected flag at +20.
claims.Limitations: This is a conditional threshold, not an unconditional probability or guaranteed appearance.

claims.Finding: A subsequent native selection path reevaluates partner conditions and the same count-dependent threshold, then updates game-over rescue state.
claims.Limitations: The trainer does not invoke this function or consume RNG.

claims.Finding: Checks bit 0x200 in the mission resource's 16-bit flags at resource+4.
claims.Limitations: This permission alone does not make rescue eligible.

claims.Finding: Game-over update dispatches its phase at object+16 and observes the rescue flag at +20 as part of its native sequence.
claims.Limitations: The trainer reports only bounded, readable state. It does not advance or replace the state machine.

claims.Finding: Native Mickey initialization increments unsigned counters RVA 0x9AD660 and 0x9AD662 with independent caps at 999.
claims.Limitations: Changing one counter is not equivalent to running this constructor; the trainer never calls it.

claims.Finding: Another native Mickey initialization path increments the same two counters independently with the 999 cap.
claims.Limitations: The two adjacent words have separate meanings and are not a single 32-bit value.

claims.Finding: The native statistics widget reads RVA 0x9AD662 for its MICKEY APPEAR display.
claims.Limitations: The roll exponent resides at RVA 0x9AD660, so its trainer edit preserves this displayed statistic.
